remark: Aarav has had a strong term in Mathematics. She demonstrates good understanding of concepts and participates actively in discussions. However, Aarav tends to become dysregulated during group tasks, which affects his ability to collaborate. He should focus on managing his responses in group settings. We look forward to seeing him continue to grow.

Priya has shown tremendous growth in every area this term. She demonstrates academic excellence across all subjects and sets a benchmark for others in the class. Priya should work harder to achieve even greater heights. Keep shining!

Rohan is a wonderful student. He is very social and always brings a positive energy to the classroom. He has made tremendous progress this year and his grades have improved significantly. We know he will make everyone proud.

Kavya is a hardworking student who participates well in Physical Education. She has shown good sportsman spirit during Sports Day. Kavya must submit work on time, must focus during lessons, and should develop her organisation skills. She needs to ask doubts more confidently. We wish her well for Grade 7.

Arjun is a thoughtful and engaged learner who contributes meaningfully to class discussions and responds well to feedback on his written work. His ability to analyse and interpret texts has developed noticeably over the term, as evidenced by the quality of his responses in the end-of-term assessment. He approaches new tasks with care and is willing to revisit his work when asked. Reviewing his answers carefully before submission will help him reduce avoidable errors and further strengthen the precision of his written expression. With consistent effort, he is well placed to make steady progress in the year ahead.

Meera is a confident student who participated in the LEAD collective this year and represented her class at KHOJ. She should work on completing assignments on time and must improve her focus during lessons. However, Meera is immature at times and needs to develop better self-regulation. We wish her all the best.
